o1.rule: Any sku that starts with `GIFT-` is free: its unit price is 0.00 whatever the catalog says.

o2.rule: Keep 2 units of every sku in reserve: only (stock - 2), never below 0, can be allocated.

o3.rule: Every order block gets one more line after `total`: `  status PARTIAL` if any of its lines has a backorder, otherwise `  status COMPLETE`.

o4.rule: order_id is case-insensitive: uppercase it, so `b7` and `B7` are the same order (and their lines merge).
